title: eludite/solution/setConfiguration
description: Select the active solution configuration and platform, and edit Configuration Manager's mapping (brief 0049; host-rpc.md, "Project properties"). `select` is remembered by the host for its own defaults (eludite/project/properties); the shell keeps it per solution. `mappings` edits the solution file preserving its formatting: `.sln` lines of `ProjectConfigurationPlatforms` are changed, added or removed in place (tabs and line endings kept); `.slnx` gets or loses the project's `<BuildType>`, `<Platform>` and `<Build>` rules for that solution configuration and platform. A written mapping reloads the solution (the generation moves on); a selection alone does not.

generation.description: The generation the shell read the values under. A value that is not the current generation fails with -32801 (ContentModified) and writes nothing: the file may have changed since (another edit, a reload).

mappings.description: Mapping edits, applied in order and written once.

generation.description: The generation after the call (one more when the file was written).

written.description: True when the solution file changed on disk.

configuration.description: A solution configuration the solution lists.

platform.description: A solution platform the solution lists.

mappingEdit.description: One cell of Configuration Manager's grid: a project in one solution configuration and platform.

project.description: Absolute path of a project file of the open solution (`.csproj`, `.vbproj`, `.fsproj`), or the project file that is open as the solution.

configuration.description: The project configuration to map to; omitted: unchanged.

platform.description: The project platform to map to; omitted: unchanged.

build.description: Build checked or cleared; omitted: unchanged.
